proposals.evidence: The full śodhana article has Prakrit sohaṇī broom and specifically Jaunsari śuain, with Kotgarhi śv̄̃ṇ and J. śū̃hṇ in the addendum. These whole broom forms match that regional contraction; the Jaunsari form with extra ṭ is excluded. Gujari sun is compared with Hindi sonī and Punjabi sūhnī, with regional contact left open.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s full akṣi entry names Khowar γeč(h), Gawri iċīn, Torwali aṣī and Maiya āc̣hī/ãc̣hī, as well as Punjabi/Lahnda akkh. These survey forms match the named regional affricate/sibilant series, including reduced vowels and alternative spellings of the same eye stem. Turner’s unexplained Khowar initial γ is preserved as an uncertainty; slash responses are included only when both members fit this family.
